name: Parentification
source:
A visual novel where you play a young woman at the precipice of Adulthood in the 80s in the Southern US. Everything seems on track for her to be stuck managing the burden of her life until an unexpected series of events leads to a life altering choice.

[From [url=https://hackerferret.itch.io/parentification]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部视觉小说，你在80年代的美国南部扮演一位正处于成年边缘的年轻女性。一切似乎都在按部就班地进行，她不得不承担起生活的重担，直到一系列意想不到的事件导致她做出改变生活的选择。

[来自[url=https://hackerferret.itch.io/parentification]Itch.io[/url]]
